about: The named business measures plx.sql {measure: ...} answers from (operating/measures.py). Each is one aggregate over one business view: value (an aggregate over the view's own columns), per (the column its value is split by: a money measure's currency or a quantity's unit; values in different currencies or units are never added), date (the column a period is read on; none: a snapshot as it stands now), where (the rows it counts), dimensions (the view's columns it may be broken down by), owner (the team that owns the definition). Every statement is made from these fields only and runs as the reader through the business views' door.

measures.name: Revenue invoiced
measures.definition: Net line revenue on posted sales invoices (item and miscellaneous lines, before tax), by invoice date. BC pilot invoices are left out (Sage is the system of record).
measures.ask: Why did revenue change last month? Which customers drove it?

measures.name: Gross margin
measures.definition: Line revenue less line cost on posted sales invoices, by invoice date. Lines without a cost are not counted, nor lines whose cost looks wrong (cost more than 5 times the line's revenue: see cost_looks_wrong). BC pilot invoices are left out (Sage is the system of record). A line whose margin the reader may not read counts in unread_cells. Read with its revenue: a margin answer gives the amount, the revenue it is on and the margin as a percent of that revenue, per currency.
measures.where: margin_basis IS DISTINCT FROM 'cost_unknown' AND NOT pilot AND coalesce(NOT (revenue > 0 AND margin < -4 * revenue), true)
measures.ask: What was our gross margin percent each month this year, per currency?

measures.name: Units sold
measures.definition: Quantity on item lines of posted sales invoices, by invoice date, per unit of measure. BC pilot invoices are left out (Sage is the system of record).
measures.ask: Which products sold the most units in the last 90 days?

measures.name: Sales invoices issued
measures.definition: Distinct sales invoices by invoice date. BC pilot invoices are left out (Sage is the system of record).
measures.ask: How many invoices did we issue each week this quarter?

measures.name: Sales orders booked
measures.definition: Distinct sales orders by order date, every status (a quote is an order type). Orders Sage holds only (Sage is the system of record for orders; FileMaker, Portal-only and BC pilot copies are left out).
measures.ask: How many orders did each salesperson book last month against the month before?

measures.name: Sales order value booked
measures.definition: Value of sales orders (not quotes) by order date. Orders Sage holds only (Sage is the system of record for orders; FileMaker, Portal-only and BC pilot copies are left out).
measures.where: order_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'quote' AND of_record
measures.ask: What will order value booked look like over the next 3 months?

measures.name: Open sales orders
measures.definition: Sales orders open now (not shipped and invoiced in full, not quotes). Orders Sage holds only (Sage is the system of record for orders; FileMaker, Portal-only and BC pilot copies are left out).
measures.where: status = 'open' AND order_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'quote' AND of_record
measures.ask: How many open orders does each customer have right now?

measures.name: Late sales orders
measures.definition: Open sales orders past their required date now. Orders Sage holds only (Sage is the system of record for orders; FileMaker, Portal-only and BC pilot copies are left out).
measures.ask: Which customers have the most late orders right now?

measures.name: Receivables open
measures.definition: What each customer account owes now: the sum of every open ledger document on the account, net. Unpaid invoices count positive; unapplied payments (receipts), prepayments and credit notes on the same account count negative and are part of the balance, not a separate figure. An account whose net is negative is owed money by us. Never net one account against another, even for the same parent company.
measures.ask: How much do customers owe us in each currency, by aging bucket?

measures.name: Receivables overdue
measures.definition: What each customer account owes now on documents past their due date, net: overdue invoices positive, the account's unapplied payments, prepayments and credit notes negative (they carry days_overdue too). Never net one account against another.
measures.ask: Who should we chase first for overdue payments?

measures.name: Payables open
measures.definition: Amount PLX owes on open Sage AP ledger documents: every payee, not only trade suppliers (card issuers such as AMEX and Visa, the tax body, payroll payees and individuals' expenses are payees too). Sage states no trade / non-trade flag: its vendor group (vendor_group: DEF, USD, PAY, PAYACH, CONTU) is how a vendor is booked and paid, so it separates payroll (PAY) but not trade from non-trade; split the trade suppliers by supplier name.
measures.ask: What do we owe suppliers right now, by aging bucket?

measures.name: Purchase order value
measures.definition: Total of purchase orders by order date, drafts left out.
measures.ask: Why did purchase order spend change last month? Which suppliers drove it?

measures.name: Purchase orders placed
measures.definition: Distinct purchase orders by order date, drafts left out.
measures.ask: How many POs did each buyer place this quarter?

measures.name: Batches produced
measures.definition: Production batches realized (made), by the date they were realized.
measures.ask: How many batches did each production line make per month this year?

measures.name: Batches on quality hold
measures.definition: Batches not cancelled whose quality status is On-Hold now.
measures.where: quality_status = 'On-Hold' AND status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Cancelled'
measures.ask: Which products have batches on quality hold right now?

measures.name: Stock on hand
measures.definition: Quantity on hand now per item, per unit of measure.
measures.ask: Which finished goods are short against open orders?

measures.name: Mail received from outside
measures.definition: Distinct non-bulk emails from a domain no PLX staff address uses, addressed (to or cc) to a PLX mailbox, by received date (a message is counted once, however many mailboxes hold it).
measures.where: NOT is_bulk AND owner_role IN ('to', 'cc') AND sender_domain NOT IN (SELECT split_part(email, '@', 2) FROM staff WHERE email IS NOT NULL)
measures.ask: Is incoming mail unusual this week against the usual week?

measures.name: Complaints said in mail and Teams
measures.definition: Complaints a model found in mail and Teams messages (comms_findings, each checked against a quote of its message), by the time it was said.
measures.ask: What are customers complaining about most in the last 30 days?

measures.name: Requests said in mail and Teams
measures.definition: Requests a model found in mail and Teams messages (comms_findings), by the time they were said.
measures.ask: What are customers asking us for most this month?

measures.name: Decisions said in mail and Teams
measures.definition: Decisions a model found in mail and Teams messages (comms_findings), by the time they were said.
measures.ask: How many decisions were made per week lately, and by whom?

measures.name: Loss on lines sold below cost
measures.definition: Line revenue less line cost on posted sales invoice lines sold for more than 0 whose cost is above their revenue (a negative margin), by invoice date: what selling below cost lost. Not counted: lines without a cost, credit or discount lines (revenue 0 or less), and lines whose cost looks wrong (more than 5 times the line's revenue: cost_looks_wrong lists them). BC pilot invoices are left out (Sage is the system of record). A line whose margin the reader may not read counts in unread_cells, never as no loss.
measures.where: margin_basis IS DISTINCT FROM 'cost_unknown' AND NOT pilot AND coalesce(revenue > 0, true) AND (margin IS NULL OR (margin < 0 AND coalesce(margin >= -4 * revenue, true)))
measures.ask: Which customers did we sell to below cost last month?

measures.name: Invoice lines whose cost looks wrong
measures.definition: Posted sales invoice lines sold for more than 0 whose cost is more than 5 times their revenue (a cost that far off the price is most likely a wrong unit cost in Sage, such as a case cost on an each line), by invoice date. They are left out of gross_margin and loss_below_cost and listed here to be checked. BC pilot invoices are left out.
measures.where: NOT pilot AND revenue > 0 AND margin < -4 * revenue
measures.ask: Which invoice lines have a cost that looks wrong?

measures.name: Customers invoiced
measures.definition: Distinct customers with a posted sales invoice, by invoice date (the customers who bought in a period). BC pilot invoices are left out (Sage is the system of record).
measures.ask: Which customers have gone quiet in the last 90 days?

measures.name: Batches rejected by QC
measures.definition: Realized (made) batches whose quality status is Rejected, by the date they were realized.
measures.ask: How many batches were rejected this year, by product?

measures.name: Mail sent by our people
measures.definition: Distinct non-bulk emails sent from a PLX staff address domain, by sent date (a message is counted once, however many mailboxes hold it); by sender for each person's mail workload.
measures.where: NOT is_bulk AND sender_domain IN (SELECT split_part(email, '@', 2) FROM staff WHERE email IS NOT NULL)
measures.ask: Who sent the most mail last month against the month before?

measures.name: Batch reject rate
measures.definition: Of the batches made (status Realized), by the day they were made, the percent whose quality status is Rejected (numerator: rejected batches; denominator: batches made). Unmade batches carry On-Hold by default and are left out.
measures.ask: What is our batch reject rate this year by production line?

measures.name: Batch QC hold rate
measures.definition: Of the batches made (status Realized), by the day they were made, the percent still on quality hold (quality status On-Hold). Unmade batches carry On-Hold by default and are left out.
measures.ask: What share of batches made this quarter is still on hold?

measures.name: Batch yield
measures.definition: Produced quantity over planned quantity, in percent, of the batches made (status Realized) that state both (planned above 0), by the day they were made: over 100 means more was made than planned.
measures.where: status = 'Realized' AND planned_quantity > 0 AND produced_quantity IS NOT NULL
measures.ask: What is our batch yield by production line this quarter?

measures.name: Share of open orders that are late
measures.definition: Of the open customer orders of record (quotes left out), the percent past their required date (days_late above 0), as they stand now.
measures.where: status = 'open' AND order_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'quote' AND of_record
measures.ask: What share of open orders is late right now, per salesperson?

measures.name: Share of receivables overdue
measures.definition: Of what customers owe (open receivable documents, net of credits), the percent past due (days_overdue above 0), per currency, as it stands now.
measures.ask: What share of our receivables is overdue in each currency?
